page_data.en:
521.
15. 10. 29.

Extract from Intelligence Report 11.10.29.

Through the efforts of Jhen Hsi-cheng, Director of the
Chinese Telegraphic Administration in Shanghai, the relations
between the local Kuomintang and the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai have been restored to a friendly basis. The
negotiations which have produced this result were facilitated
by the release on September 22 of Wang In Ziang, a prominent
member of the 7th District Kuomintang, who had been
detained in connection with the extortion of $4,200.00 from Mrs.
Chang Hsueh-liang on the pretext that the monies which in the
aggregate came to this amount had been expended in order to
secure the solution which was given by the British Authorities
in connection with the death of her husband.

As a result of the re-establishment of friendly relations
between the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the Kuomintang,
the danger of Colonel Yuang Liung, Chief of the Public Safety
Bureau, losing his position has been removed for the time being.
page_data.zh:
521.
1929年10月15日。

摘自1929年10月11日的情报报告。

经上海中国电报局总监郑希成（Jhen Hsi-cheng，音译）的努力，当地国民党与大上海市政府之间的关系已恢复友好基础。促成这一结果的谈判，得益于王因祥（Wang In Ziang，音译）于9月22日获释。王是国民党第七区的重要成员，此前因涉嫌以张学良夫人名义勒索4,200.00美元而被拘留，借口称这笔款项已用于获取英国当局对其丈夫死亡一案所作的裁决。

随着大上海市政府与国民党之间友好关系的重建，公安局局长袁良上校暂时免去了失去职位的危险。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 521
File No.
Date. 23.9.29

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

September 20, 1929.

Sir,
Wong Yien Hsiang 王燕祥 member of the 6th District
Koumingtang and also a prominent member of the "Support
Committee Chang Hsien Liang case" was arrested at the
Public Safety Bureau on Sept 12 whilst accompanying
the widow of Chang Hsieh Liang to the bureau.
As a result of enquiries at the Public Safety Bureau
it appears that when the agitation was at its height
over the Chang Hsieh Liang case, Wong Yien Hsiang 王燕祥
Chang Hung Kwei 张鸿贵 Sung Tien Kwei 沈天桂 Chiang Liu
Tsz and Chang Lien En 张连恩 members of the 6th district
Koumingtang wrote to the Public Safety Bureau to the effect
that the family of Chang Hsieh Liang was being importuned
by two fellow provincials named Yen Kwei Tang 严桂堂 and Tsuan Wen Tsing 崔文清 who on the pretext of having claims
for debts on the deceased were taking advantage to
utilise the family to enrich themselves. The letter
requested the despatch of 4 Constables from the Public
Safety Bureau to protect the family of Chang and
thereby to save them from the hands of the alleged
extortioners. The Public Safety Bureau complied with
this request. With the policemen at their disposal
Wong and his associates kept Chang Hsueh Liang's family
in their custody, at the same time they continued their
agitation through the medium of the press for compensation
from the British Authorities. The family of Chang
Hsueh Liang was thus not free and when they went to
the Bureau of Foreign Affairs about two weeks ago
to receive the $5000 compensation they were accompanied
and escorted by Wong Yien Hsiang and Chang Hung Kwei.
The latter after the payment took the widow and the son

（批：d Cl. Information 9/9. JCN）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 521
档案号
日期：1929年9月23日

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

1929年9月20日。

先生，
国民党第六区党员、也是“支持张学良案委员会”重要成员的王燕祥（Wong Yien Hsiang），于9月12日陪同张学良遗孀前往公安局时，在公安局被捕。

经向公安局查询，据悉在张学良案闹得最凶的时候，国民党第六区党员王燕祥、张鸿贵（Chang Hung Kwei）、沈天桂（Sung Tien Kwei，音译）、蒋刘子（Chiang Liu Tsz，音译）和张连恩（Chang Lien En）致函公安局，称有两名同乡严桂堂（Yen Kwei Tang）和崔文清（Tsuan Wen Tsing，音译）借故声称对死者拥有债权，趁机利用张家家属中饱私囊，骚扰张家。信中请求公安局派遣4名巡捕保护张家，使其免受所谓勒索者的侵害。公安局同意了这一请求。王及其同伙利用手下的巡捕将张学良家属置于其控制之下，同时继续通过媒体鼓动，要求英国当局给予赔偿。因此，张学良家属并不自由，约两周前他们去外事局领取5,000美元赔偿金时，由王燕祥和张鸿贵陪同并护送。后者在付款后带着遗孀及其儿子

（批注：d Cl. Information 9/9. JCN）

page_data.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
2
to a lodging house at the Small East Gate and forced
them to pay $4,200 out of the money received from the
Bureau of Foreign Affairs in order to cover their
(Wong and Chang's) expenses.
At this juncture Yen Kwei Tang and Tsuan Wen Tsing
the two Tungchow provincials who were also interested
in this case had a row with Wong and his associates
over a division of the money. This seemingly angered
Wong and he caused their arrest and detention in the
City Police. Whilst there the prisoners were brought
face to face with Chang Hsueh Liang's wife and son
The latter denied having paid any money to Yen and Tsuan
but instead accused Wong Yuen Ziang. Chang Hung Kwei
and Shen Ting Kwei of robbing them as stated above.
Wong is still being detained despite the request
made by the 6th district Koumingtang for his release.
It is reported that efforts are being made to
obtain his release through Nanking.
Clerical Assistant.
Actg D.C.I.
This arrest is said to be the real
cause of the Kuomintang attack on
Yuan Liang. It will be a good thing
for local administration if Yuan wins
but but the strength of Kuomintang influence
in Nanking is against it. However I think
we may expect interesting developments shortly.
HR 21.9.29

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
2
前往小东门的一家客栈，并强迫他们从从外事局收到的钱中支付4,200美元，以支付他们（王和张）的费用。

此时，同样对此案感兴趣的两位通州籍人士严桂堂和崔文清，因分钱问题与王及其同伙发生争执。这似乎激怒了王，他导致两人在市警察局被捕并被拘留。在那里，囚犯与张学良的妻子和儿子当面对质。后者否认曾向严和崔支付任何款项，反而指控王燕祥、张鸿贵和沈庭奎（Shen Ting Kwei，音译）如上所述抢劫了他们。

尽管国民党第六区要求释放王，但他仍被拘留。据报道，正试图通过南京方面努力获得他的释放。
文书助理。
代理副督察长。
据说此次逮捕是国民党攻击袁良的真正原因。如果袁良获胜，对地方行政将是好事，但国民党在南京的影响力对此不利。不过，我认为我们不久可能会看到有趣的发展。
HR 1929年9月21日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
P.B. Chinese Section
REPORT
File No.
SHAI MU
C.I.D.
O.L. 521
Date September 16, 1929.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Wong Yien Hsiang.

Made by C.D.I. J.W. Prince. Forwarded by Tho Robertson C.D.I.

Reference to the attached, the man Wong Yien Hsiang
(王祥) mentioned in the warrant was arrested at the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau on the morning of September 12. On the above
date Wong Yien Hsiang accompanied the widow of the deceased man
Chang Hsueh Liang (張學良) to the Public Safety Bureau Offices to
request the authorities to expedite proceedings in the latter's
case. When Wong Yien Hsiang made himself known to the authorities
he was promptly arrested and detained, the woman being allowed to
return home.

The other man Chang Hung Kwei (張鴻奎) mentioned in
the warrant has not yet been located, and it is presumed that he has
absconded. His correct address is No 282 Tang Dong Ka Loong , not
341 / 3 Taspoo Road.

A.C.Pol'.
J.W.Prince
C. D. I.

SHAI MU
刑事侦缉处
O.L. 521
日期：1929年9月16日。

主题（全称）：逮捕王燕祥。

由刑事侦缉督察 J.W. Prince 制作。由刑事侦缉督察 Tho Robertson 转发。

关于附件，传票中提到的男子王燕祥（王祥）于9月12日上午在上海公安局被捕。当日，王燕祥陪同死者张学良（張學良）的遗孀前往公安局办公室，请求当局加快处理其后者的案件。当王燕祥向当局表明身份时，他随即被捕并被拘留，该女子被允许回家。

传票中提到的另一名男子张鸿贵（張鴻奎）尚未找到，推测其已潜逃。其正确地址为唐东卡弄（Tang Dong Ka Loong，音译）282号，而非乍浦路341/3号。

警察助理专员。
J.W. Prince
刑事侦缉督察。

Translation of a despatch No.633 from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau to the Police Department, International Settlement dated September 11, 1929:-

Sir,

This bureau was in receipt of a letter from the Shanghai Support Committee to the Chang Hsueh-liang's Case, which states :-

"According to information furnished by some creditors of the late Chang Hsueh-liang, namely :
Chang Hung-kwei (張鴻奎)
Sung Ting-kwei (沈庭奎)
Kiang Jui-tsz (江瑞兹)
Chang Lie..-en (張建恩)
and others, several Tungchow loafers including Yen Kwei-teng (嚴桂堂) and Tsuan Wen-tsing (崔文俊) have forcibly handled the money and property of the Chang family and thus prevented them from discharging the Chang family's debts. Subsequently they were sent to the Police to be dealt with. Inquiries indicate that they were no relatives of the Chang family nor representatives of any local societies. They were simply endeavouring to effect a settlement of the case between the imperialists and the Chang family. We found out their plot beforehand, and therefore had Chang's wife sent to the Central Lodging House, Small East Gate where she was temporarily kept with a police escort. Their plan was thus frustrated. Then they spread rumours against this committee and even sent out rowdies to create trouble at the home of a member of the committee. This was reported to the Police by our man named Kiang Te-ling (姜德麟). We have spent some $200 for the maintenance of Chang Pao-sz (張寶氏) (Chang's wife), and have suffered still greater loss in regard to our reputation. We intended to request you to take stringent measures, but we desisted in consideration of the case being on the way towards settlement. When Chang's wife received the solatium these loafers again interfered with their home affairs and monetary matters. Police was again notified to investigate into the matter and punish these miscreants according to law."

When the two men Yen and Tsuan were detained at the Police, inquiries instituted by the 2nd District Police Station indicated that the accusations against them were not facts. Chang Pao Sz was also called and questioned and she said that Yen and others never handled her money, nor prevented the discharge of the debts. Chang Siao Mau (張小毛), son of the late Chang Hsueh-liang, however, submitted a statement to the effect that when he and his mother received the solatium from the Bureau for Foreign Affairs and were on their way home, they were forced by :-

MUN
D. R.
521.
1929年9月13日。

上海公安局于1929年9月11日致国际租界警务处的第633号公函译文：-

先生，

本局收到上海“支持张学良案委员会”来函，内容如下：-

“据已故张学良的一些债权人提供的信息，即：
张鸿奎（張鴻奎）
沈庭奎（Sung Ting-kwei，音译，原文拼写与下文略有不同）
江瑞兹（Kiang Jui-tsz，音译）
张建恩（Chang Lie..-en，原文不清，推测为張建恩）
等人称，包括严桂堂（Yen Kwei-teng）和崔文俊（Tsuan Wen-tsing，音译，原文拼写与上文略有不同）在内的几名通州无赖强行处置了张家的钱财和财产，从而阻碍张家偿还债务。随后他们被送交警方处理。调查显示，他们既非张家亲属，也非任何本地团体的代表。他们只是企图达成帝国主义者与张家之间的案件和解。我们事先发现了他们的阴谋，因此将张妻送往小东门中央收容所，并在警察护送下暂时看管。他们的计划 thus 受挫。随后他们散布针对本委员会的谣言，甚至派出流氓到一名委员会成员家中滋事。此事由我方人员姜德麟（Kiang Te-ling）向警方报告。我们为维持张宝氏（Chang Pao-sz，即张妻）的生活花费了约200美元，并在声誉方面遭受了更大损失。我们本打算请求你们采取严厉措施，但考虑到案件正在走向解决，故未实行。当张妻收到抚慰金时，这些无赖再次干涉其家务和财务事宜。再次通知警方调查此事，并依法惩处这些恶棍。”

当严和崔两人被警方拘留时，第二区警察分局进行的调查表明，对他们的指控并非事实。张宝氏也被传唤讯问，她说严等人从未经手她的钱，也未阻碍债务清偿。然而，已故张学良之子张小毛（Chang Siao Mau）提交了一份陈述，称他和母亲从外事局收到抚慰金并在回家途中时，被迫由：-

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Chang Hung-kwei (張鴻奎)
Sung Ting-kwei (沈庭桂) and
Wong Yien-hsiang (王燕祥)

to go with them to a big house where they forcibly took away
from us banknotes to the amount of $1,650. From this, it
appears that Chang, Wong, and their followers have committed
extortion and have fabricated false accusations against others.
I shall feel much obliged if you will kindly detail officers to
assist our detectives to effect the arrest of
Chang Hung-kwei (張鴻奎),
Nos.341/3 in an alleyway of Tsapoo Road, near
North Shansi Road.
and Wong Yien-hsiang (王燕祥),
No.863 Wong Kya Hang, off Connaught Road.
and, when arrested, have them handed over to us for trial so
as to get the case cleared up.

Signed: Yuan Liang (袁良)
Chief of the Police.

P.S. -- A warrant issued by the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
for the arrest of the two-named is appended herewith
for your reference.

- 2 -

张鸿奎（張鴻奎）
沈庭桂（Sung Ting-kwei，音译，此处汉字为沈庭桂）和
王燕祥（Wong Yien-hsiang）

带他们去一所大房子，在那里他们强行从我们手中拿走金额为1,650美元的钞票。由此可见，张、王及其追随者实施了勒索，并对他人捏造虚假指控。如蒙贵方派遣警员协助本局侦探实施逮捕：
张鸿奎（張鴻奎），
地址：北山西路附近乍浦路某弄堂341/3号。
及王燕祥（Wong Yien-hsiang），
地址：康纳路（Connaught Road）旁王家行（Wong Kya Hang，音译）863号。
并在逮捕后将他们移交我局审判，以便结案，我将不胜感激。

签名：袁良（Yuan Liang）
警察局长。
